summary: Lightspeed Commerce filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its second-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings release for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue was $323.8 million, organic growth 15% but 2% as reported, with net loss of $4.2 million ($0.03/share) and Adjusted EBITDA of $22.7 million. The release references the April 28, 2026 Upserve divestiture as a comparability item, but no new transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. Routine results filing; watch organic growth versus reported growth and cash flow.
